observation: The HUB contents API returned byte-identical payloads for every utf-8 file, but re-encoded the four BOM'd utf-16 stdout captures to utf-8 with a BOM (3,168 -> 1,586 bytes for the probe capture), while the returned git blob sha still equaled the sha1 of the local file.
remediation: The four literal stdout captures are delivered as .stdout.raw.b64 (pure ASCII base64 of the exact captured bytes) with the sha256 of the decoded bytes recorded; the earlier .raw binaries were removed from the bundle so no file claims a literal-byte carriage it does not have.
not_affecting: No JSON, markdown, code or transcription content was altered; only the encoding of four capture containers changed.
